name: Mary Drake
source:
The leader of the pirate crew Golden Hind who more or less owns the HM Fort Loughs present on the eastern side of Palastra Island. A cheerful and free-spirited girl, she wields a giant labrys in battle and strikes fear into her enemies, while seeming like a cool and reliable person to her allies. A true pirate, she is used to skirmishes on the high seas, and is also well versed in black-market transactions and hidden routes for commerce.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
